limitations: Lengths, diameters, flow, and path counts are synthetic software-test values, not physiological evidence.
Perfused path count is static; recruitment and precapillary sphincter dynamics are not implemented in M4.3.
Substances pass through without exchange, reaction, retention, adhesion, or extravasation.
The model has no pressure, hematocrit, local position, stochastic dispersion, or molecular channel.
